notice: Official VAL is no longer an untouched confirmation set for the Stage9 hypothesis.

training.selection: strict minimum DevSelectionScore=.5 OverallDevSoftCE+.5 MacroTypeDevSoftCE; all variants
training.epoch_remainder: carry across epoch boundaries; no short optimizer batch; no resampling

gate_input: nearest current selected-neighbor distance/50; no neighbor=1
graph: unchanged Stage8 G1 15D/17D; nearest<=50m current-valid self-excluded max8; K6; one message layer; raw47 value, hidden145 attention; LayerNorm shared representation then type adapter
normalization: reuse Stage8 HeadTrain statistics columns0:3-14 and1:0-10; gate history uses0:5-7; count/distance not z-scored; no semantic tensors

tiny.entropy: same objective weighting as each variant; T3 H=.5 micro entropy+.5 present-type macro entropy

Neighbor0_distance_group: excluded from distance bins; retained in Neighbor0 and Overall

decisions.TypeAdaptation: T2-T1 Ped reliable improvement plus no reliable Overall/Vehicle harm; negative Ped point with CI containing0 => WEAK_SUPPORTED under same no-harm conditions
decisions.BalancedTraining: T3-T2 Ped point delta<=0 and no reliable Overall/Vehicle harm
decisions.TAFIG: T3-R2 Overall reliable improvement; no reliable Vehicle/Ped/Bicycle harm; Ped point delta<=+.01m
decisions.TAFIG_STRONG: inherits TAFIG; reliable Vehicle improvement and Ped point<=0; STRONG_PLUS if Ped CI_upper<0
decisions.PedestrianNegativeTransferResolved: T3-R2 Ped point delta<=+.01m and no reliable harm
decisions.PaperUsableTAFIG: TAFIG SUPPORTED and VehicleBenefitRetained YES and PedestrianNegativeTransferResolved YES; provisional development evidence only
decisions.RecommendedFinalModel: T3 if PaperUsableTAFIG YES else frozen previously recommended R2; no VAL-based retraining/selection
decisions.ReadyStage9BConfirmatoryCV: YES iff TAFIG SUPPORTED; recommendation only, no execution

case_selection: after aggregate; requested categories; lexical identities for ties; four distinct actor instances; high gate is top quartile of evaluated T3 Vehicle gates, descriptive only; high interaction=Neighbor6-8; if category unavailable document without substitute claims
semantic_boundary: no semantic inputs or semantic module in T1/T2/T3; G3 is a frozen Stage8 reference evaluated separately on identical candidates only
